faqs.q: Sec. 18-399. - I.P.C. Section 412.2, Floor drain traps.
faqs.a:
Section 412.2. Floor drain traps,
is hereby added to read as follows:
"
412.2. Floor drain traps.
Floor drains shall be installed in all grade occupancies where all portions of a
                  floor level, finished or not, is not entirely below finish grade level at all points
                  and that area has therein a water heater, a steam or hot water boiler, or water connections
                  for a clothes washer. Floor drains shall be located in full view at all times and
                  readily accessible for servicing."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 11, 9-14-2020)
